gaps.topic: Dialysis or end-stage renal disease
gaps.why: Label silent beyond 'not recommended in moderate or severe impairment'.

gaps.topic: Live or live-attenuated vaccines
Oral contraceptives other than levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol
Breastfeeding safety
Patients starting with low lymphocyte counts
Head-to-head efficacy versus any other therapy
gaps.why: Study B had an open-label comparator arm; the label reports no results for it and names no comparator.

gaps.topic: Whether QUORVANTA is better tolerated (GI or flushing) than dimethyl tavorate
gaps.why: No comparative tolerability data in the label; ADR-006 says only that the profile was consistent.

gaps.topic: Non-relapsing (primary progressive or non-active progressive) Brennick syndrome
Use in any condition other than Brennick syndrome
Missed dose instructions
Overdose management

gaps.topic: Combination with other disease-modifying therapies
Efficacy beyond 2 years
gaps.why: Pivotal studies were 2 years; long-term data in the label are exposure counts only (ADR-003).

gaps.topic: How the drug works
gaps.why: Mechanism unknown (PHA-001); PHA-002 must not be offered as the mechanism.

gaps.topic: Opening capsules for patients who cannot swallow
Plan-specific coverage, a patient's actual cost, formulary status, or a recommendation among network pharmacies
gaps.why: Access claims (ACC-001 to ACC-010) cover availability, prescribing route and program terms; plan-specific and patient-specific answers, and any preference among pharmacies, are not in the library.
gaps.expected_behaviour: answer from ACC claims where they apply, then access_referral message

gaps.topic: Advice for an individual named or described patient
gaps.why: Bot does not give individual patient advice; may also be an AE.
